# Aunt Jamesina

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v3 c16 P52](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0052)</sub>
- **Titles:** queen of housemothers  <sub>[v3 c35 P5](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0005)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Aunt Jimsie  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)</sub>

## Appearance

Aunt Jamesina is a tiny old woman with a small, softly-triangular face and large, soft blue eyes filled with youth and hope. She has pink cheeks and wears her snow-white hair in quaint little puffs over her ears. She dresses in an old-fashioned style.

_Sources: [v3 c16 P52](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0052), [v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053)_

## Personality

Aunt Jamesina is sweet, mirthful, and holds old-fashioned opinions and clothes that she finds comfortable. Although she loves Phil, she admits she cannot understand her. She hates visiting others and has a strong, proper respect for the clergy.

_Sources: [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 c18 P2](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0002), [v3 c19 P40](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0040), [v3 c20 P10](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0010), [v3 c37 P42](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0042)_

## History

Aunt Jamesina was named after her father, James, who drowned at sea prior to her birth. Later in life, after her daughter Elizabeth married and moved to India as a foreign missionary, Aunt Jamesina was left alone in a large house. She agreed to move to Kingsport to act as housekeeper at Patty's Place for Anne, Priscilla, Phil, and Stella, quickly winning their deep affection. While managing Patty's Place, she kept house alongside three cats, including her bed-companion the Sarah-cat, whose purring comforted her worries about snakes in India. After the college girls completed their studies, she eventually traveled to India to explore her daughter's mission field despite her dread of snakes.

_Sources: [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c16 P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), [v3 c18 P25](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0025), [v3 c36 P11](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0011), [v4 c3 P16](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0016)_

## Background by volume

- father named James was drowned at sea a month before she was born  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)</sub>
- always wanted a yellow silk dress, but her mother and husband refused to allow it  <sub>[v3 c19 P6](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0006)</sub>
- used to laugh at her beaux in her youth  <sub>[v3 c35 P21](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0021)</sub>

## Quotes

> I mean to take it real easy here. I know you expect me to look after you and keep you proper, but I’m not going to do it. You’re old enough to know how to behave if you’re ever going to be. So, as far as I am concerned, you can all go to destruction in your own way.  <sub>[v3 c16 P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053)</sub>

> I always wanted a yellow silk dress, but first my mother and then my husband wouldn’t hear of it. The very first thing I’m going to do when I get to heaven is to get a yellow silk dress.  <sub>[v3 c19 P6](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0006)</sub>

> If you are going to marry a minister, you will have to give up such expressions as ‘dig in.’  <sub>[v3 c35 P5](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0005)</sub>

> You’ve been to college four years and I never was, but I know heaps more than you do, young ladies.  <sub>[v3 c37 P14](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0014)</sub>

> That boy ought to sleep with a rubber band around his head to train his ears not to stick out. I had a beau once who did that and it improved him immensely. It was I who suggested it to him and he took my advice, but he never forgave me for it.  <sub>[v3 c37 P40](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0040)</sub>
